Here are three popular picks under ₹20,000 from what I know. Prices are launch-time figures and may have changed, so check the current price before you buy.

Phone	Price (approx.)	Chip	Screen	Camera and battery
Redmi Note 13 5G	₹17,999	Dimensity 6080	6.67" AMOLED, 120Hz	108MP, 5000mAh, 33W charging
Realme Narzo 70 Pro 5G	₹19,999	Dimensity 7050	6.67" AMOLED, 120Hz	50MP with stabilisation, 5000mAh, 67W charging
Moto G84 5G	₹19,999	Snapdragon 695	6.5" pOLED, 120Hz	50MP with stabilisation, 5000mAh, 30W charging

The Narzo 70 Pro is the best all-rounder for speed and charging, the Redmi Note 13 is the cheapest, and the Moto G84 has the cleanest software with few pre-installed apps.
